name: Call the Great Beast (Daimoinon, Advanced, Methuselah)

system.description: A Methuselah-level power known to only one living Baali at a time, requiring months of ritual and scores of sacrifices whose exact requirements are lost. If the rite succeeds, the priest expends her entire Willpower pool and hurls her soul at the barrier between worlds, extinguishing her essence to grant something from Beyond a foothold on this world. It has never been used successfully.
